subject.title: [Feature]:   Add configurable send hotkey for WebChat (Cmd+Enter instead of Enter)

question: Should the WebChat send-shortcut preference live in scoped Control UI settings, gateway/openclaw.json config, or both?
rationale: Current docs retire persisted WebChat config while the existing nearby preference path is browser-local scoped UI settings; the owner choice determines the compatible implementation shape for the linked PR.

options.title: Use Scoped UiSettings
options.body: Add the preference to the existing scoped Control UI settings path and keep gateway WebChat config retired unless a separate operator need is approved.

options.title: Add Gateway Config
options.body: Introduce a documented openclaw.json WebChat setting with explicit compatibility and doctor expectations despite the current retired-config stance.

options.title: Support Both Surfaces
options.body: Provide an operator default plus browser-local override, accepting the larger precedence, docs, and upgrade burden.

recommendation.title: Use Scoped UiSettings
recommendation.body: Add the preference to the existing scoped Control UI settings path and keep gateway WebChat config retired unless a separate operator need is approved.

likelyOwner.reason: They provided prior review context on this issue and appear in recent current-main Control UI/settings history, making them the best available owner for the settings-scope call.
